new_delta: Monotone aggregate authority state is insufficient under concurrent check-then-act; effect release requires atomic reservation/consumption or an equivalent concurrency-safe linearization mechanism.
Introduce a third runtime identity, authority_reservation_id, separate from semantic_hash and contract_instance_hash; it is host-created and non-derivable by model-authored code.
Async authority semantics must define enqueue, transfer, reserve, commit, completion, cancellation and lease renewal/revalidation points.

Final RC2 readiness should be gated by real WASI 0.3, transactional broker concurrency, Rust/C++/plugin FFI, destructive-equivalent sandbox red team, actual parser/typechecker/canonicalizer, target-Qwen 4B and analyzable policy-plane tests.
